title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: About the size of the value displayed on the card/document page (textbox too small to read?)
summary: When text fields exceed the display capacity of page textboxes in Business Central, developers can use the MultiLine property, Rich Text feature, FactBox components, or action-triggered dialogs to present the content readably. This matters for fields like Customer Name that can store long values but appear truncated on the web client.
key_points: Text fields in Business Central support up to 2048 characters but may appear truncated on small textbox areas in the web client
The MultiLine property combined with a wrapper group and ShowCaption set to false expands the display area for long text
Rich Text feature with ExtendedDatatype set to RichContent handles multimedia content and large text blocks effectively
FactBox components positioned on the right side of pages can display related long-form content without cluttering the main layout
Developers can trigger full text display through user actions like OnAssistEdit to show content in a dialog without taking up page space

quotes.text: The maximum length for a field of type 'Text' is 2048 AL.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the technical limit for standard text fields, informing the choice of solution (Blob for longer content).
